headline: PENTAGON BETS $725M ON ENERGY FUELS — DOW SIGNS CONDITIONAL RARE EARTH LOAN; UUUU STOCK SURGES 16%
snippet: The U.S. Department of Defense's Office of Strategic Capital committed a conditional loan of up to $725 million to Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE: UUUU; TSX: EFR) on June 18, 2026, to fund a new domestic rare earth separation and metallization plant — the largest single U.S. government financing commitment to a critical minerals project to date. The loan requires Energy Fuels to satisfy financial, legal, and technical due diligence conditions before closing, and is designed to complement the company's pending acquisition of Australian Strategic Materials Ltd. (ASX: ASM), whose Korean Metals Plant already produces NdPr and other rare earth metals for permanent magnet manufacturing — with the ASM shareholder vote scheduled for June 22. Energy Fuels shares jumped 16% on the announcement, signalling the market's recognition that a DoD-backed combined Energy Fuels-ASM entity would become the world's largest vertically integrated rare earth producer outside China, spanning the chain from uranium-bearing ore and oxide separation through metal reduction and final alloy output at White Mesa Mill in Utah. For investors tracking the mine-to-magnet supply chain thesis, a $725 million government commitment — made before the acquisition vote closes and before construction begins — is the most concrete institutional validation of the Western rare earth build-out seen in the current cycle.

headline: HAWKISH FOMC KNOCKS GOLD $160, SILVER -6.6% — WARSH'S FIRST FED MEETING SPLITS DOT PLOT; DOLLAR HITS 1-YEAR HIGH
snippet: Gold fell more than $160 per ounce and silver posted its sharpest single-session drop in weeks after the Federal Reserve's June 16-17 FOMC meeting — Chair Kevin Warsh's first — held the Fed funds rate at 3.50-3.75% but released a hawkish dot plot that split the committee down the middle on whether to hike before year-end, driving the U.S. Dollar Index to its highest level since May 2025. Silver dropped 6.6% before recovering approximately 70% of the move to $69.83/oz, while gold traded near $4,165 per ounce — more than $1,400 below its January 28 all-time high of $5,589 and near four-month lows. The odds of an October rate hike rose to more than 70% following the dot plot, compounding a reversal of the June 15 precious metals rally that had been triggered by the US-Iran Strait of Hormuz interim peace agreement. With U.S. markets closed for Juneteenth on June 19, the FOMC-driven repricing across gold, silver, and the GDX miners ETF will not be absorbed by U.S. trading until Monday — creating a window for continued volatility if rate hike probabilities remain elevated heading into the next PCE inflation print.

headline: K2 GOLD CONFIRMS LARGE NEVADA EPITHERMAL — 210m GOLD CORRIDOR AND BOILING-ZONE VEINS AT Si2 IN ESMERALDA COUNTY
source_name: Newsfile Corp. / K2 Gold Corp. (TSXV: KTO)
snippet: K2 Gold Corporation (TSXV: KTO) announced June 18, 2026 results from its 2026 reverse circulation drill program at the Si2 Gold Project in Esmeralda County, Nevada — confirming a large, fertile low-sulphidation epithermal gold-silver system across three widely separated target areas, with hole SR26006 at AOI4 returning consistently elevated gold over 210 metres and every hole encountering extensive adularia flooding, epithermal quartz veining, and broad zones of disseminated gold. K2's technical team models a 'boiling zone' at depth where higher grades concentrate, and the 2026 program successfully accessed that horizon in multiple holes — the key structural validation for planning a focused high-grade drill program. Esmeralda County is Nevada's most productive gold-silver epithermal belt, hosting multiple multi-million-ounce past producers, and a system confirmed across three separated areas of interest — with 200+ metre gold-bearing intervals plus boiling-zone quartz veins at depth — supports the interpretation of a district-scale epithermal system rather than a single isolated deposit. For Nevada gold investors, the combination of broad low-grade envelope and demonstrated boiling-zone access is the two-tier structure that has historically hosted the highest-grade epithermal deposits in the Great Basin.

headline: VIZSLA COPPER FIRES UP PALMER VMS — $19.2M, 10,000m, 2-RIG ALASKA PROGRAM ATTACKS SOUTH WALL HIGH-GRADE COPPER CORE
source_name: Investing News Network / Vizsla Copper Corp. (TSXV: VCU)
snippet: Vizsla Copper Corp. (TSXV: VCU) announced June 18, 2026 that diamond drilling has commenced at the Palmer VMS Project in Southeast Alaska under a $19.2 million (US$13.7 million), 10,000-metre, two-rig program running June through September 2026 — with initial drilling targeting the South Wall Zone where prior holes identified the highest copper grades on the entire Palmer Deposit, followed by the HG and Waterfall prospects for new discovery potential west and east of the main deposit. Palmer hosts copper, zinc, gold, silver, and barite in a world-class polymetallic VMS system where all primary metals are classified as critical or strategic under U.S. executive orders, giving the project unusual supply-chain relevance for U.S. critical mineral policy. At COMEX copper near $5.89/lb and U.S. refined copper imports more than doubling year-over-year as buyers front-run potential Section 232 tariffs ahead of the June 30 Commerce Department deadline, an Alaska VMS system advancing into its most aggressive drill campaign in company history represents a strategically well-timed discovery-expansion program in one of the few politically stable VMS belts within reach of the North American copper tariff thesis.

headline: SOUTHERN SILVER LAUNCHES 12,500m CERRO LAS MINITAS INFILL — PURO CORAZON DRILL TO DRIVE Q3 RESOURCE UPDATE AND PEA
source_name: Investing News Network / Southern Silver Exploration Corp. (TSXV: SSV)
snippet: Southern Silver Exploration Corp. (TSXV: SSV) announced June 18-19, 2026 that crews have mobilized and definition drilling has commenced at the Puro Corazon target of the Cerro Las Minitas polymetallic silver-lead-zinc project in Durango, Mexico — a program of up to 12,500 metres of infill drilling across a 400-metre strike, 450-metre depth Ag-Pb-Zn system designed to increase resource classification confidence for a Mineral Resource Estimate update and Preliminary Economic Assessment revision both scheduled for Q3-Q4 2026. The 2025-26 drilling program confirmed multiple high-grade intercepts and extended the Puro Corazon zone for the full 400-metre claim strike to more than 450 metres depth — substantially expanding the system from the prior technical report. With silver recovering from a post-FOMC 6.6% selloff and trading near $69/oz — approximately 43% below its January 28 all-time high — a Durango silver-polymetallic project advancing two near-term institutional catalysts (resource update and PEA update in the same quarter) represents a specific, timed pathway to re-rating in a segment of the silver equity market where most peers are still waiting for either a drill result or an engineering study, not both simultaneously.

headline: CASSIAR GOLD OPENS NORTH BC CAMP — 10,000m TAURUS DEPOSIT DRILL SETS UP ALONGSIDE HISTORIC HIGH-GRADE SOUTH EVALUATION
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Cassiar Gold Corp. (TSXV: GLDC)
snippet: Cassiar Gold Corp. (TSXV: GLDC) announced June 18, 2026 the opening of its 2026 exploration camp and commencement of a 10,000-metre Phase 1 diamond drilling program at the Taurus Deposit in the Cassiar North project area of northern British Columbia — simultaneously advancing high-priority Cassiar South targets including Newcoast, Hopeful, and Snow Creek, where historic quartz vein production ran at average head grades of 10-20 g/t Au. The company has a fully funded $5.5 million program and a dual-strategy structure that gives investors exposure to two separate value-creation theses: a bulk-tonnage resource expansion at Taurus through systematic infill and step-out drilling, and a high-grade vein discovery program at Cassiar South where known structures are being tested for depth extensions and blind parallel systems identified through new geophysical and geochemical data. Northern BC's Cassiar mining district has produced gold continuously since the early 20th century, and the combination of bulk-tonnage potential at Taurus and high-grade vein upside at Cassiar South — both funded and running simultaneously — makes this one of the more ambidextrous junior gold exploration programs underway in Canada heading into the summer discovery window.

headline: SILVER STORM CLEARS 62-PAD MEXICO PERMIT — SEMARNAT GREENLIGHTS La PARRILLA SURFACE DRILL PROGRAM IN DURANGO SILVER CAMP
source_name: Investing News Network / Silver Storm Mining Corp. (TSXV: SVRS)
snippet: Silver Storm Mining Corp. (TSXV: SVRS) announced June 18, 2026 receipt of SEMARNAT approval for construction of 62 surface drill pads and 27 access roads at its La Parrilla Silver Mine Complex in Durango, Mexico — the federal environmental permit that gates the company's planned 3,000-metre initial surface drilling program targeting the 14 Marcos zone to a depth of 300 metres, with the authorization valid for four years and an additional 10-year approval issued for the existing tailings storage facility. La Parrilla is a past-producing underground silver mine complex in Durango's prolific Guanaceví silver corridor, and securing surface permits for 62 drill pads reflects a program scope substantially larger than typical initial Mexican surface programs — management has clearly planned for multiple phases of follow-up work rather than a single exploratory campaign. Mexican SEMARNAT permits in the Durango mining corridor are known for lengthy processing timelines; their receipt removes the primary regulatory constraint between Silver Storm and generating the first surface drill intercepts from a property with an existing underground silver resource, creating a clear technical catalyst runway into H2 2026.

headline: AIS RESOURCES HITS 33.8 g/t AU AND 3.28% CU IN NEW BRUNSWICK ROCKS — ANTIMONY PEAKS 9,600 PPM ACROSS LEPREAU AND SCOTT FALLS CAMP
source_name: Investing News Network / A.I.S. Resources Limited (TSXV: AIS)
snippet: A.I.S. Resources Limited (TSXV: AIS) announced June 18, 2026 final overlimit assay results from its New Brunswick projects — with rock chip and grab samples at the Little Lepreau prospect returning 33.8 g/t Au and 9.97 g/t Au in gold, eight samples grading above 1% Cu with a peak of 3.28% Cu, and six samples above 500 ppm antimony with a high of 9,600 ppm Sb across the Prince of Wales, Little Lepreau, and Scott Falls Dam prospects. The 23-sample batch required overlimit re-assay after initial results exceeded upper detection limits for copper, gold, silver, and antimony — confirming a genuinely high-grade polymetallic surface expression. A.I.S. holds a farm-in option to earn up to 75% interest in Riversgold's (ASX: RGL) Saint John Project by spending C$4.4 million over four years. The antimony angle here is the strategic differentiator: with the U.S. having designated antimony a critical mineral under executive order and China controlling roughly 90% of global primary production, a high-grade antimony-gold-copper camp in Atlantic Canada at the stage where overlimit surface grab samples establish the grade framework for systematic drilling represents a genuinely early entry point in one of 2026's most policy-supported critical mineral themes.

headline: AI MAPS 10 URANIUM TARGETS ACROSS 3,407 km² IN NUNAVUT — VRIFY DORA FLAGS UNDRILLED LAMBDA ZONE NEXT TO MOUNTAIN LAKE URANIUM
source_name: Mining Weekly / Future Fuels Inc. (CVE: FTUR)
snippet: Future Fuels Inc. (CVE: FTUR) announced June 17, 2026 results from its AI-assisted prospectivity mapping program using VRIFY's DORA platform across the 3,407 km² Hornby Basin Uranium Project in Nunavut — identifying 10 high-priority exploration targets including the Lambda Target immediately south of the historic Mountain Lake uranium system and five previously unrecognized targets (Sigma, Alpha, Rho, Tau, Iota) in underexplored areas, all ranked using VRIFY Prospectivity Scores that measure similarity to known mineralized systems by integrating geophysics, geochemistry, drilling data, structural geology, and alteration patterns. Future Fuels plans 2026 airborne geophysics, mapping, and geochemical sampling to validate the AI-generated targets and advance them toward a drill permit, with the Lambda Target's proximity to a documented historic uranium occurrence providing the highest-confidence starting point. The DORA platform represents a departure from conventional grassroots exploration methodology that is appearing with increasing frequency in large-land-package uranium programs where 3,000+ km² of geology cannot be systematically evaluated through traditional field work alone. At uranium spot near $86/lb with U.S. utilities under-contracted for 13 consecutive years and AI hyperscalers (Meta: 7.8 GW of nuclear PPAs; Microsoft: 800+ MW of dedicated reactor capacity) emerging as a new uranium demand class in Q1 2026, a Nunavut district-scale land package with 10 AI-ranked targets at the edge of known mineralization is positioned for the summer discovery season.

headline: GOLDGROUP STARTS US$8M 24,000m SONORA GOLD DRILL — SAN FRANCISCO MINE RESTART DECISION TARGETED END-2026
source_name: Investing News Network / Goldgroup Mining Inc. (TSXV: GGA)
snippet: Goldgroup Mining Inc. (TSXV: GGA) announced June 18, 2026 the commencement of a US$8 million, 24,000-metre diamond core drilling program at its 100%-owned San Francisco gold project in Sonora, Mexico — the first new drilling at the property in many years and the first step in an explicitly production-restart-oriented program targeting a mining restart decision by end-2026 or early 2027, with drilling expected to complete in Q3 2026. San Francisco is a past-producing open-pit heap-leach gold project in Sonora — the same geological and commercial context as Heliostar Metals' La Colorada mine currently expanding its Veta Madre pit at $4,165/oz gold — and the 24,000-metre program collects the resource model optimization and engineering data needed to underpin an updated mine plan, a capital cost estimate, and a production timeline. A 24,000-metre program is one of the larger single-commitment exploration drill programs announced by a TSXV company in 2026, and at a production-restart-ready asset it converts faster than a greenfield discovery program: each hole feeds directly into a resource update and engineering database rather than a multi-year delineation sequence. The decision to commence an $8M restart engineering drill at gold near $4,165/oz — 25% below the January ATH but still meaningfully above every heap-leach production cost model for Sonora open-pit gold — demonstrates management's conviction that the current price environment supports restarting production.

headline: SILVER RATIO AT 61.7 SIGNALS OUTPERFORMANCE — GOLDSILVER.COM: JUNE CORRECTION 'WAS THE SETUP' FOR NEXT SILVER BULL LEG
snippet: GoldSilver.com's June 2026 silver price outlook argues that the metal's more-than-43% correction from its January 28 all-time high of $121/oz to current levels near $67-70 should be read as 'the setup' for silver's next bull leg rather than a structural reversal — centring on the gold-to-silver ratio at 61.7 as the key trigger indicator. A ratio in the 60-70 range has preceded silver outperformance versus gold at every major inflection point of the current bull cycle, and the current level reflects both the depth of silver's post-FOMC drawdown and silver's well-documented pattern of lagging gold during corrections before violently outperforming when investor sentiment shifts. The piece notes that silver is heading for its sixth consecutive annual supply deficit at a time when retail investor allocations are near multi-year lows — the classic accumulation-window setup that has preceded the sharpest quarterly moves in silver over the past two decades. For junior silver mining investors holding explorers and developers that have corrected even harder than the metal itself, the June 2026 setup — ratio at historical reversal levels, supply deficit building, retail sentiment near lows — provides a thesis anchor for holding existing positions through short-term Fed policy noise.
